consumer: The frontend paperdoll renderer reading avatar.carried_items[], asking 'which item occupies the wielded slot and which items fill each worn body-part slot, for display'
scope: only the character's own carried items, narrowed to the wielded item and the worn slots (not nearby ground items, not general inventory)
decisive_source: arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items -- iterates ctx.u.wielded_items() then ctx.u.worn, tagging each emitted item with location 'wielded'/'worn'/'inventory', producing exactly the slot-partitioned view the paperdoll displays
divergence: A character wielding a weapon and wearing several layered garments: the paperdoll must show the wielded item in the hand slot and worn items in their body slots; a wrong answer that sourced from nearby ground items (map::i_at) or tagged plain inventory items as 'worn' would render an item in a paperdoll slot the GUI would never display it in
